subtitles.en: We actually don't think that's ambitious at all. That's pretty much in line with what other hypersteaders in the U.S. and some of the new cloud players in the States are saying.

subtitles.en: A three-year payback time is incredibly good in all opinion.

subtitles.en: And this is necessary and very much needed for Adivabas cloud business because they are the only really hyper-scatter that's providing CSP, that's cloud service provider, to the rest of the tech companies and to all enterprises in China for the AI compute needs.

subtitles.en: And we have a little problem for the central yard.

subtitles.zh: 小问题，非常小的问题。

subtitles.en: Yeah, because one single company has at least 75% of the time.
subtitles.zh: 因为一家公司就占了至少75%的面积。

subtitles.en: So actually, there's only around 70,000 square feet to land out for the phase one.
subtitles.zh: 所以一期其实只有约7万平方英尺待租。

subtitles.en: So the phase one will be delivered by the end of this year and to be open, hopefully around mid-year.
subtitles.zh: 一期将在今年年底交付，希望年中左右开业。
en_highlights: delivered by the end of this year

subtitles.en: So the central is doing quite well, as you see, the occupancy is high.
subtitles.zh: 中环表现相当好，入住率很高。

subtitles.en: And there's a little bit of upside adjustment for rental as a whole, not just us.
subtitles.zh: 整体租金有轻微上调，不只是我们。

subtitles.en: But overall, the other areas are still challenging.
subtitles.zh: 但总体而言，其他区域仍面临挑战。

subtitles.en: The central is the central. The high end is the high end.
subtitles.zh: 中环就是中环，高端就是高端。

subtitles.en: But we see little progress in other areas.
subtitles.zh: 但其他区域进展甚微。

subtitles.en: But of course, the student hostel helps some of the outside areas.
subtitles.zh: 当然，学生公寓对部分外围区域有帮助。

subtitles.en: Like East Cologne or the Far West Cologne is helped by the student hostel favor at the moment.
subtitles.zh: 比如东九龙或西九龙，目前都受惠于学生公寓。

subtitles.en: Can you ask about that? How quickly is the student boom?
subtitles.zh: 能谈谈这个吗？学生潮有多快？

subtitles.en: Boosting the profile of the real estate.
subtitles.zh: 提升了房地产的形象。

subtitles.zh: 关于学生涌入的报道和讨论很多。

subtitles.zh: 这是你想利用的机会吗？你怎么看？

subtitles.zh: 去年我们在一个项目上做了实验。

subtitles.en: I think it's quite satisfactory, but conversion into commercial or from industrial to student hostel is still quite costly.
subtitles.zh: 效果相当满意，但从工业改造成学生公寓成本仍然很高。

subtitles.en: So it really varies. We do not have a lot of buildings available for changing into student hostels anyway.
subtitles.zh: 所以情况各异。我们也没有太多楼宇可以改造成学生公寓。

subtitles.en: And the residential we wife, so we do not really look at that.
subtitles.zh: 住宅方面我们已有布局，所以不太考虑这个。

subtitles.en: But I think it helps the banks to sell some of the restructure assets.
subtitles.zh: 但我认为这有助于银行出售一些重组资产。

subtitles.en: I think it's good. As a whole, because we structure assets can be released.
subtitles.zh: 我认为这是好事，整体上重组资产可以被释放。

clips.title: 租金降10%：恒地CFO说透，内地商业地产

subtitles.en: I want to get your take on the mainland as well.
subtitles.zh: 我也想听听你对内地的看法。

subtitles.en: It looks like rental in when it comes to the commercial side is seeing still low occupancy.
subtitles.zh: 商业地产的租金似乎仍然低迷，入住率也低。

subtitles.en: Rents are also a bit down.
subtitles.zh: 租金也有所下降。

subtitles.en: I think you were down some 10% the first half.
subtitles.zh: 上半年大概下降了10%。

subtitles.en: Do you see signs of when this sort of sector actually returns to growth again?
subtitles.zh: 你认为这个行业何时能恢复增长？

subtitles.en: It's just as a CFO I do not really supervise day to day.
subtitles.zh: 作为CFO，我并不直接管理日常运营。

subtitles.en: But look at the numbers.
subtitles.zh: 但看数据。

subtitles.en: I doubt that there will be an immediate revival in rentals.
subtitles.zh: 我怀疑租金会立即回升。

subtitles.en: As whole AI wave to cut the demand for office space.
subtitles.zh: 整体上AI浪潮削减了对办公空间的需求。

subtitles.en: And look at the numbers, I would be doubtful if there will be a certain revival.
subtitles.zh: 看数据，我对是否会有明显复苏持怀疑态度。

subtitles.en: Because of AI you think.
subtitles.zh: 你认为是因为AI？

subtitles.en: I think AI as a whole, well, the mainland's property market is still quite oversupply at the moment.
subtitles.zh: 我认为AI整体上，内地地产市场目前仍然供过于求。

subtitles.en: And of course AI and the job market do not have too much.
subtitles.zh: 当然，AI和就业市场也没有太多关联。

subtitles.en: So I will not paint a OC picture on the second half for mainland investment properties.
subtitles.zh: 所以我对下半年内地商业地产的前景并不乐观。
